title: Hospice Room-and-Board Share Days in a Notice-Billed Month
content:
On Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a resident on the Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board tier has part of an actual-billed month priced at the tier's room-and-board share of the Medicaid daily rate — 95 percent on that tier (0 percent on every other tier) — which is what the program pays the hospice for those days and against which patient pay is credited.

**Formal clause.** The first day of an actual-billed month priced at the hospice room-and-board share: where the case is on the Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board tier and the hospice was elected before the month began, the month's first day; where the case is on that tier and the hospice election date falls inside the month, the election date; otherwise none (the first day of the next month). From that first day the month's Medicaid days, but never more than the days from that first day to the month's end, are priced at the tier's room-and-board share of the Medicaid daily rate. Those days are priced as a kind of their own and rounded half up to the cent.

**Input — judgement — output.**

| Tier of the case | Hospice election date on the case | First share day | Share days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board | before the month began | the month's first day | the month's Medicaid days, at most every day of the month |
| Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board | inside the month | the election date | the month's Medicaid days, at most the days from the election date through the month's end |
| Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board | after the month, or none | none | none |
| any other tier | any | none | none |

The "month's Medicaid days" are the days of the month left at the Medicaid daily rate once the days that carry no cost or another price are counted out.

**Hypothetical example.** A case on the Hospice Room and Board tier; hospice elected on day 18 of a 30-day month; Medicaid daily rate 251.83 dollars. The days from the election date through the month's end number 13 (days 18 to 30). If the month has 22 Medicaid days, 13 of them are share days, priced as one kind: 13 multiplied by 251.83, multiplied by 95, divided by 100, which is 3,110.1005 dollars, rounded half up to the cent as a total — 3,110.10 dollars. If the month has only 9 Medicaid days, all 9 are share days.
